title: Hitting-time bound along a walk
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $u,v$ be vertices. For every walk $p$ from $u$ to $v$ and every natural number $N$, the cumulative miss probability for hitting $v$ from $u$ through step $N-1$ is at most $\operatorname{length}(p)D(|V|-1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
